verdict.rationale: GoDaddy APIs authenticate with Personal Access Tokens tied to specific capability scopes. The docs cover creating, storing, using and revoking PATs, and show granular per-operation scopes such as `commerce.order:*` (read/create/update/cancel) and `commerce.channel:read`, which supports issuing least-privilege tokens for an agent. However, the gddy agent skill runs on the user's own authenticated session rather than a dedicated scoped credential. Missing for 10: domain-API scope granularity and per-resource restrictions, token expiry/TTL controls, agent-specific credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
